description: A developer or a RoTerminal member: what kind they are (a RoTerminal member, a Roblox account not on RoTerminal, or both), their RoTerminal profile, their Roblox account (joined, verified, followers), the studio they run and others they’re with, the Roblox groups they own and their roles in others, the games on their own account, the games they worked on, their Developer Award hats, their latest posts and open jobs. Give the game or studio they’re at as context whenever the question names one (“Lucky Matt at Tribes 3v3”): people tied to it win, and `ties` says how. `ask` means two people fit: ask which. Never for someone who only plays games.

context.description: The game or studio they’re at or with, when the question names one (optional)

person.description: Their @username, name, Roblox id, or a link to their roterminal.co or Roblox profile
